environment: Mac16,7 arm64, macOS 26.6.2; Blender 5.2.1 LTS build 9e2066aef7ef; Firefox 159.0; Three.js 0.187.0; Playwright 1.65.1.

details.findings: Both cupped ears, thumb hooks, angular scallops and the amber pendant are legible. A thin blue welt separates the dark wing tips in the source and GLB. The listening tilt, opening reaction and two-wing ability gesture stay articulated. The idle chest lifts and returns to its ground stance. Native and Firefox material colors and moving parts correspond across the sampled views. The native render has softer bounced shadows.
details.tool: Firefox 159.0, Three.js GLTFLoader and AnimationMixer, Playwright canvas captures, agent image inspection
